content.title: Five Views on Apologetics
content.author: Steven B. Cowan, editor (Grand Rapids: Zondervan, 2000)
content.note: Five evangelical writers each state and defend one method (classical, evidential, cumulative case, presuppositional, Reformed epistemology) and reply to the others.
